glossary.radiation.definition: Humna ijaan hin mul’anne, hawaa keessa socho’u.
glossary.particles.definition: Wantoota xixiqqoo saffisaan deeman; garee miidhu.
glossary.cosmicRays.definition: Raayii humna guddaa hawaa fagoo irraa dhufu.
glossary.shield.definition: Dallaa furdaan caccaba obomboleettii aduu dhaaba.
glossary.radioDelay.definition: Yeroo mallattoon hawaa keessa darbuuf fudhatu.
glossary.twoStars.definition: Ji’a irratti saayinsii 8, Maars irratti 3 argadhu.
glossary.threeStars.definition: Xumura irratti fayyaa 50 yookaan isaa ol qabaadhu.
simplified.point1: Booltiin, humni, qilleensi fi fayyaan lakkoofsa taphaati; NASA miti.
simplified.point2: Miidhaan obomboleettii tilmaama taphaati; safartuu yaalaa miti.
simplified.point3: Caccabni dhugaan tilmaama dura dhufuu danda’a.
simplified.point4: Daangaan dogoggora tilmaamaa murtii taphaati; odeeffannoo NASA miti.
simplified.point5: Ifni aduu ifa qofa. Caccabni saffisaa garee miidha.
simplified.point6: Obomboleettiin Maars guddaan urjii sadii hin kennu.
teacher.title: Storm Watch: Barumsa Hawaa Daqiiqaa Kudhan
teacher.goal: Barattoonni Ji’aa fi Maars irratti filannoo obomboleettii aduu madaalu. Urjii lamaaf Ji’a saayinsii 8, Maars saayinsii 3 barbaada.
teacher.bases: Ji’a: Buufata Entoto. Maars: Buufata Dallol.
teacher.activity1: Obomboleettiin duumessa xixiqqoo fida jettee tilmaami.
teacher.activity2: Ji’a Barataa, sanyii 101 fi obomboleettii 2024-05-11 filadhu.
teacher.activity3: Guyyaa torba taphadhu; gorsa oolchaa dubbisi.
teacher.activity4: Obomboleettii walitti qabi; bu’aa ergamaa madaali.
teacher.activity5: Sanyii 101 fayyadamuun obomboleettii Maars irratti yaali.
teacher.activity6: Aduu, turtii raadiyoo fi fayyaa garee madaali.
teacher.activity7: Qormaata Kutaa bani; bu’aa garee galmeessi.
teacher.question1: Maaliif gaachanni hir’ina fayyaa guyyaa hunda hin dhaabu?
teacher.question2: Kutaa tokko dabalataa hojjechuun yoom balaa qaba?

teacher.learning1: Gaachanni caccaba aduu hir’isa; raayyaa koomiikii miti.

info.about.data: Daataan obomboleettii NASA DONKI irraa dhufa. Dhugaan raadiyeeshinii NASA irraa dhufa.
info.about.ai: Meeshaaleen AI koodii fi barruu barreessuuf gargaaran. Ijaaraan faayiloota hunda sakatta’e.
info.about.placeNames: Maqaawwan Entoto fi Dallol Itoophiyaa yaadachiisu. Entoto Addis Ababa gubbaa wiirtuu ilaalcha urjii qaba. Dallol ho’aa fi halluu qabu Afar keessa jira. Saayintistoonni Maars fakkaatu jedhanii qoratu.
info.about.branding: Tapha kana keessatti mallattoon NASA hin jiru. Tapha NASA miti.
